organizationId.description: ID of the contact center organization. This field is required for all bulk save operations.

id.description: ID of this contact center resource. It should not be specified when creating a new resource. However, it is mandatory when updating a resource.

version.description: The version of this resource. For a newly created resource, it will be 0 unless specified otherwise.

name.description: Indicates the name of the skill. Once created, name cannot be modified.

description.description: Indicates the description of the skill.

serviceLevelThreshold.description:
Allows to set the time that a customer request can be in a queue before the system flags it as outside the service level. 

 If the agent completes a customer service request within this time interval, the system considers it within the service level. 
It is required only for a create or an update operation.

items.description: If skillType is enum, the skill can take different sub-values which are defined with this field. For instance, a skill named "tech support" may have enumSkillValues for "windows", "macOS" and "linux".

active.description: Indicates the status of the skill whether it is active(when true) or not active(when false). It is required only during a create or an update operation.

dynamicSkill.description: Indicates whether the skill is a dynamic skill or not. Default value is false.

skillType.description:
This can be of the following types

PROFICIENCY: id = 0

BOOLEAN: id = 1

TEXT: id = 2

ENUM: id = 3

Once created, skillType cannot be modified.

createdTime.description: This is the created time of the entity.

lastUpdatedTime.description: This is the updated time of the entity.
